HostSlugs.Name: Chip host items
HostSlugs.Hint: Comma-separated item slugs (or names) that can hold a spell chip. A GM can also allow any single item from the install dialog.

Install.Title: Install {chip}
Install.Label: Device
Install.OtherGear: Other gear (will be marked as a computer)
Install.NoHosts: {actor} has no comm unit or computer to install a spell chip in.
Install.DeviceOccupied: {device} already holds {chip}. Each device can hold only one spell chip.

Cast.Destroyed: {chip} is destroyed and can no longer be used.
Cast.Broken: {chip} is broken and must be repaired before it can be used.
Cast.NotInstalled: {chip} must be installed in a comm unit or computer before it can be used.
Cast.DeviceNotHeld: You must hold {device} in one hand to cast from {chip}.

Overclock.Title: Overclock {chip}?
Overclock.Content:
{chip} has already been used today.

Overclocking casts the spell again, then requires a DC {dc} flat check: on a success the chip is broken, on a failure it is destroyed.

Burnout.Title: Overclock {chip} again?
Burnout.Content:
{chip} has already been overclocked today.

Overclocking it again destroys the chip and casts no spell.
Burnout.Message: {actor} overclocks {chip} a second time today. The chip is destroyed and no spell is cast.

Error.NoConsumableClass: SF2e Spell Chips could not hook into the system's consumable items. Spell chip rules are not being enforced.
